title: VaR backtesting: Kupiec, Christoffersen and the Basel traffic light
source:
"""Backtest a 99% VaR: Kupiec POF, Christoffersen independence, Basel traffic light.

Kupiec asks whether the exception RATE matches 1%; Christoffersen asks whether
exceptions CLUSTER (a model can have the right count and still fail when the
breaches arrive together); conditional coverage adds the two statistics.

Zero counts are normal in a good model (often n11 = 0), so every x*ln(y) term
uses the 0*ln(0) = 0 convention, and a transition rate with an empty
denominator is 0. The traffic light is regulatory and looks only at the last
250 trading days.
"""
import json
import math
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import chi2

INPUT = "/input/environment/data/var_backtest.csv"
OUT = "/app/output/var_backtest.json"
P = 0.01


def xlogy(a: float, b: float) -> float:
    return 0.0 if a == 0 else a * math.log(b)


def main() -> None:
    d = pd.read_csv(INPUT)
    exc = (-d["pnl"] > d["var_99"]).astype(int).to_numpy()
    n, x = len(exc), int(exc.sum())

    lr_pof = -2 * (xlogy(n - x, 1 - P) + xlogy(x, P)) + 2 * (xlogy(n - x, 1 - x / n) + xlogy(x, x / n))

    prev, cur = exc[:-1], exc[1:]
    n00 = int(((prev == 0) & (cur == 0)).sum())
    n01 = int(((prev == 0) & (cur == 1)).sum())
    n10 = int(((prev == 1) & (cur == 0)).sum())
    n11 = int(((prev == 1) & (cur == 1)).sum())
    p01 = n01 / (n00 + n01) if n00 + n01 else 0.0
    p11 = n11 / (n10 + n11) if n10 + n11 else 0.0
    pi = (n01 + n11) / (n00 + n01 + n10 + n11)
    lr_ind = -2 * (xlogy(n00 + n10, 1 - pi) + xlogy(n01 + n11, pi)) + 2 * (
        xlogy(n00, 1 - p01) + xlogy(n01, p01) + xlogy(n10, 1 - p11) + xlogy(n11, p11))
    lr_cc = lr_pof + lr_ind

    last = int(exc[-250:].sum())
    zone = "green" if last <= 4 else ("yellow" if last <= 9 else "red")

    report = {
        "n_days": n, "n_exceptions": x, "exception_rate": x / n,
        "kupiec": {"lr": lr_pof, "p_value": float(chi2.sf(lr_pof, 1))},
        "christoffersen_independence": {"lr": lr_ind, "p_value": float(chi2.sf(lr_ind, 1)),
                                        "n00": n00, "n01": n01, "n10": n10, "n11": n11},
        "conditional_coverage": {"lr": lr_cc, "p_value": float(chi2.sf(lr_cc, 2))},
        "traffic_light": {"window_days": 250, "exceptions": last, "zone": zone},
    }
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(report, fh, indent=2)
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
